vignette.title: Farida is 45. She owns four apartments in Heliopolis.
paragraphs: Every month, collecting rent is a negotiation, a chase, a headache. She has no contracts that anyone respects. No system for tracking payments. No way to handle disputes without it getting personal.
Managing four apartments takes more of her time than her actual job. And she knows people who own twenty.
Omens exists so Farida doesn't have to be the collections department, the contract office, and the dispute referee for the rest of her life.
vignette.pullquote: Her side hustle owns her evenings — and scaling feels impossible.

howItWorks.title: Three things change the day you join.

steps.title: You sign one lease.
steps.body: Tenant signs the digital lease through Omens. OTP-verified. Bilingual contract. Five minutes.

steps.title: We pay you on the 1st.
steps.body: Every month — InstaPay, Vodafone Cash, or bank transfer. We absorb the timing risk. You absorb a quiet morning.

steps.title: Trust becomes portable.
steps.body: Every payment builds (or damages) the tenant's Omens Score. Bad tenants become unrentable across the network. Good tenants get rewarded.

pillars.title: Three promises. Kept on the first.

items.title: Guaranteed Payout
items.lede: Rent in your wallet on the 1st of every month.
items.body: Even if the tenant pays late. Even if they don't pay at all. Our Takaful pool covers the gap so you never feel it. One flat monthly fee covers everything — guaranteed timing, dispute mediation, and zero collection labor.

items.title: Pay-early discount
items.lede: Tenants who pay 5+ days early get 5% off — paid for by Omens.
items.body: We use float yield to fund the discount, so it costs you nothing. Tenants who pay early stay longer, refer better tenants, and build their Omens Score faster. The incentive aligns the whole network.

items.title: Omens Score
items.lede: A portable credit score that follows the tenant.
items.body: Every on-time payment, every dispute, every late month — recorded, weighted, scored 0–100. Landlords in the network see the score before approving. Bad tenants run out of places to hide. Good tenants get pre-approved.

forTenants.title: A rental record that follows you — and saves you money.
forTenants.body: Browse verified apartments from landlords who already trust Omens. Pay your rent in one tap, build a portable Omens Score, save 5% every time you pay early. No middleman. No awkward conversations. Just a calmer relationship with your home.

pricing.title: Two tracks. Pick the one that fits.

subscription.title: Flat monthly fee. No surprises.
subscription.lede: One predictable charge per unit, tiered by your rent. Most landlords pay this.
subscription.tiersHint: Per unit. Bundle pricing available at 5+ units.

managed.title: We take the whole portfolio.
managed.lede: For landlords with 10+ units, mixed-use properties, or leases that need a hand on every door. We sit on your side of the table, end to end.
bullets: Direct ops support — phone, WhatsApp, in-person
managed.priceHint: Tailored to your case — usually starts where Track 01 leaves off.

pricing.comparedTo: Compared to ~15–20% of yearly rent you'd lose to vacancy, chasing, and disputes.

items.q: What happens if my tenant stops paying?
items.a: Nothing — for you. We keep paying you on the 1st while we handle the collection through our Khalas grace process, payment plans, and (if needed) a three-person majlis dispute panel. The tenant's Omens Score absorbs the damage; you absorb a quiet morning.

items.q: How is this different from a real estate broker?
items.a: A broker introduces a tenant and disappears. Omens stays — guaranteeing your rent, building your tenant's credit history, mediating disputes, and (eventually) helping you scale to ten or twenty units without losing your evenings.

items.q: Is this legal? Can the contract be enforced?
items.a: Yes. We use Egyptian civil-law contracts that landlords and tenants both sign with OTP verification. The contracts are admissible in Egyptian courts, but in practice the Omens Score and majlis mediation resolve almost every dispute before it gets that far.
Tenants get one Ramadan flex per year — a one-month payment plan with no score impact and no fee. It's how we handle a real cultural moment with grace. You still get paid on the 1st.

items.q: What if I want to sell my apartment?
items.a: You can. The Omens lease transfers cleanly to the new owner, or we'll help you negotiate the buyout. We never lock you into anything you wouldn't be able to do without us.

finalCta.title: Two doors. One promise.
finalCta.subtitle: Whether you own a unit in Heliopolis or you're searching for one — Omens is what comes next. Tell us where to find you.
